items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And so Frank said, why wouldn't you speak about him?

ctx.x: He was out on the coast a long time. Yes, he was.

And so many people that knows us, and we never, never mention Jellie, you know, and they'd say, I want you to go down to Cabildo and see this artist down here. He's simply—I said, well, that's my brother. He's on number 30 on the list, you know what I mean? And so Frank said, why wouldn't you speak about him? I said, well, sometimes it hurts.
Well, do you remember seeing your brother then any other time after, say, around 1906, when he was six years old, until you went and she called him?
